card.name: Sentence ends and digits in risk statements
card.fires_on: The period after 'risk of bleeding events' in NSAID warnings, the zero in '10' in numeric ranges or durations, and 'resolved' after 'were transient'.

modes.label: Period after bleeding risk
modes.description: The sentence-ending period after 'may increase the risk of bleeding events' in NSAID label text.
modes.example: NSAIDs, including mefenamic acid, may increase the risk of bleeding events<<.>> Co-morbid conditions such as co

modes.label: Zero in number 10
modes.description: The digit 0 in '10' or '1000' within durations or measurements.

modes.label: Resolved after transient
modes.description: The word 'resolved' following a description of changes that were transient.

card.writes: It suppresses words meaning temporary or transient, so it seems to steer the model away from repeating such words.
card.plain: It fires at a few spots in label text, such as the end of a bleeding-risk sentence or the zero in 10, and it discourages the word 'temporary' next.
